title: Affine model pointing compatibility
statement: Given the hypotheses, a local pointed etale triple t, a global pointed etale triple c, a map i : c.B → t.B, and the structure equation c.α ≫ i = algebraMap(R, Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal) ≫ t.α, the descended map preserves the residue-field pointing equation.

proof.text: Deleted as false after the certified counterexample in the delivered module: the diagonal map R → R × R followed by the two coordinate projections satisfies the structure equation but yields distinct pointings. The sole caller is repaired to use the compatible-model theorem directly. The counterexample uses Mathlib’s SpecToEquivOfField equivalence and its inverse law directly; no duplicate field-point helper theorems are retained.

proof_origin.note: Repair X-cbd87: declaration deleted because false; caller adapted to UniqueAuxCompatible. Repair X-039e3: remove duplicate private helpers and use the Mathlib equivalence directly.
